events.title: Ashen Ascent
events.message:
Ash has fallen for a thousand years.

Above the grey, they say, a keep still drifts on the wind, and in its highest tower burns the last ember.

You have no legs. You have a hammer. Climb.

objects.name: A note, left by a kinder corpse

events.title: A note, left by a kinder corpse
events.message:
Sweep the hammer over the stone, hook the far side, and pull.

There is no death on this mountain. Only falling, and the long climb back.

events.title: Hollow Hamlet
events.message:
Once a village. Its people still keep watch, though they no longer remember what for.

The hollowed take two honest blows before they fall.

events.title: The Ossuary
events.message:
The hamlet buried its dead beneath its feet, then followed them down.

Here the way up begins by going down.

events.title: Blighted Mire
events.message:
Beneath the bones the mountain rots. A great serpent sleeps across the only road.

Messages here were written by the drowned. Read them like it.

events.title: The drowned stair
events.message:
The drowned did not lie.

A warm draft rises where the swamp swallowed the old stair, all the way up to the forge.

events.title: Cinder Forge
events.message:
The ash is still warm here. The ironkeepers hammered a road up the mountain's throat and never came back down.

The orange stone burns nothing but pride.

events.title: Frostbound Ramparts
events.message:
A fortress raised to hold back the sky, now held fast by ice.

What looks solid is only cold, and what is cold may crack.

events.title: Windward Stair
events.message:
Above the frost the wind never rests. The old stair fell long ago; the gusts remember where it stood.

Let the wind carry you, but steer.

events.title: Not the keep
events.message:
Someone planted this flag and called it the top.

The keep drifts higher still. Listen for the wind.

events.title: The Drifting Keep
events.message:
It drifts on air that should not hold it. Its guard never left the walls.

The ember waits above its highest tower.

events.title: A veil of mist
events.message:
Pale mist, cold as a held breath. Beyond it the keep's guard still keeps its watch.

There is no turning back that is not a fall.

events.title: Treasure ahead
events.message:
A gilded chest, unguarded, in the middle of the courtyard.

Surely whoever left it here meant well.

events.title: It was a mimic
events.message:
It was always a mimic.

But something stirs in the dark below: a draft, warm and upward.

events.title: A view of nothing
events.message:
Ash to every horizon, and the keep a smudge above it.

Nothing else up here. Climb back down.

events.title: Try jumping
events.message:
Written in pale light at the brink, by a hand that is barely there.

The ledge beyond looks solid enough.

events.title: Ember reclaimed
events.message:
At the top of the drifting keep a single ember still burns.

It is warm, and small, and it fits inside your pot.

Below, for the first time in a thousand years, the ash stops falling.
